title: An interpretable machine learning approach for quantitative structure-permeation prediction of polymeric microneedles
authors: Su J; Song Y; Wu H; Li Y; Shen P; Ji Y
relevance_ja: DMNのpolymer・drug構造と透過を直接結ぶ
key_fact_ja: 18文献・353データ・10 base polymers・24 small-molecule drugs・36 curvesを統合し、PISD入りCatBoostがindependent testでR² 0.869を報告
limitation_ja: curve・drug・paper単位のgroup holdoutか公開範囲で確認できず、未知薬物の外部性能とは断定できない

title: Integrating experiments, numerical simulations and Bayesian optimisation to maximise drug permeability of hollow pyramidal microneedle arrays
authors: Prakash R; Nadda R; Abraham AM; Yalcin TE; Donnelly RF; Das DB
relevance_ja: HMN幾何・実測透過・FE・Bayesian optimisationを直接統合
key_fact_ja: ibuprofen sodiumとex vivo neonatal porcine skinでCOMSOL予測が実験の6%以内、diamond配置はsquareより約5%高いpermeabilityを報告
limitation_ja: 単一薬物・特定porcine skin/deviceの検証で、dataはrequest扱い

title: Mechanistic Modelling of Transdermal Delivery Dependence on Drug Properties
authors: Benbrook N; Zhan W
relevance_ja: MN輸送に対する薬物物性9因子を直接分析
key_fact_ja: diffusivity、複数partition、protein binding、transvascular permeability、skin elimination、plasma clearanceの層別影響を解析
limitation_ja: simulation sensitivityであり、新規Franz curveや臨床データの予測精度ではない

title: Model-based analysis of nanocarrier-mediated transdermal drug delivery with coated microneedles
authors: Benington B; Zhan W
journal: European Journal of Pharmaceutics and Biopharmaceutics
relevance_ja: coated MNから層別skin/bloodへのnanocarrier輸送を直接モデル化
key_fact_ja: 4 skin layersのconvection-diffusion-reactionとblood kineticsを結合し、coating thickness・release・diffusivity等の層別影響を報告
limitation_ja: homogeneous/isotropic layerとtransepidermal pathwayを仮定し、appendageal transportを無視

title: Numerical modelling for hollow pyramidal microneedle-based drug-loaded particles delivery for controlled drug release
authors: Nadda R; Das DB
relevance_ja: HMN内粒子輸送・skin deposition・drug releaseを直接結合
key_fact_ja: 2–8 µm particles、40–70 µm lumen、PVA/PLA/PGAを比較し、500 s releaseはsingle needle 8%対4×4 array 50.64%と報告
limitation_ja: ibuprofenと仮定parameterに依存する数値研究で、外部実験精度ではない

title: Numerical modelling for coupled flow, transport, pharmacokinetic and pharmacodynamic of tablet-loaded hollow microneedle patch for transdermal drug delivery
authors: Prakash R; Nadda R; Das DB; Donnelly RF
relevance_ja: tablet-loaded HMNのflow・transport・PK/PDを直接結合
key_fact_ja: needle数9から36でibuprofen permeabilityがほぼ2倍となり、高圧はpermeability向上とdelivery control低下のtrade-offを示した
limitation_ja: diluted speciesとしてinter-species interactionを無視した数値モデル

title: Multiphysics modelling of the impact of skin deformation and strain on microneedle-based transdermal therapeutic delivery
authors: Shu W; Kilroy S; Ní Annaidh A; O'Cearbhaill ED
relevance_ja: insertion deformation・strainとMN透過を直接結合
key_fact_ja: deformationだけでinsulin permeationが25%低下し、strain効果で24 hにさらに45%低下すると予測
limitation_ja: FE結果の25%・45%を普遍的補正係数として使えない

title: Modelling Hollow Microneedle-Mediated Drug Delivery in Skin Considering Drug Binding
authors: Bhuimali T; Sarifuddin; Das DB; Mandal PK
relevance_ja: viscoelastic skin・ISF・bindingを含むHMN輸送を直接モデル化
key_fact_ja: verapamilのskin metabolism、blood/tissue compartments、reversible saturable bindingを結合し、tip diameterとinjection velocityの影響を報告
limitation_ja: monolayer viable skin/two-compartment modelで、animal/bench verificationが未了

title: Mathematical modelling of hollow microneedle-mediated transdermal drug delivery
authors: Benbrook N; Zhan W
relevance_ja: HMNから各skin layerとbloodへの輸送を直接モデル化
key_fact_ja: release、infusion、MN length、vascular permeability、nanocarrier diffusivity、environmentのtarget-layer別影響を報告
limitation_ja: 数理感度研究であり、一般的accuracyや未知薬物の外部妥当性は示さない

title: Numerical modeling and simulation for microneedles drug delivery: A novel comprehensive swelling-obstruction-mechanics model
authors: Yang P; Song Q; Zhang L; Liu Z; Ma H
journal: European Journal of Pharmaceutics and Biopharmaceutics
relevance_ja: hydrogel MNのswelling・obstruction・mechanicsを直接統合
key_fact_ja: cross-sectional shapeとpenetration depthがdrug release efficiencyへ大きく影響すると報告
limitation_ja: abstractで独立実験による予測誤差は提示されない

title: Optimising distribution of hollow microneedle in arrays for transdermal drug delivery considering effects of tissue compression on drug permeability
authors: Nadda R; Das DB
relevance_ja: HMN array配置・圧縮とskin permeabilityを直接関連付ける
key_fact_ja: geometry・skin物性から最適化関数gを定義し、高分子薬物のpermeability Kを推定
limitation_ja: theoretical optimisationであり、新device適用前に同じskin/drugで校正が必要

title: Biophysical simulation of transcutaneous drug delivery for the rational design of hollow microneedle-based insulin infusion
authors: Mohizin A; Sung B
relevance_ja: HMN insulinのmicrofluidics・skin mechanics・pain・PKを直接統合
key_fact_ja: injection layer、flow、tip opening、depthがtissue transportとplasma insulin curveを変えると予測
limitation_ja: insulinとactive hollow-MN infusionに特化し、passive solid/DMNへ転用できない

title: Modeling of Dissolving Microneedle-Based Transdermal Drug Delivery: Effects of Dynamics of Polymers in Solution
authors: Yadav PR; Hingonia P; Das DB; Pattanayek SK
relevance_ja: DMN dissolution・ISF boundary・drug transportを直接モデル化
key_fact_ja: PVP–ceftriaxone modelが文献ex vivo permeationとheight reductionに合い、0.39 mg loadingで24 hに約93% systemic clearanceを予測
limitation_ja: ex vivo値は文献由来でprospective external experimentではなく、93%は一般的回収率ではない

title: Development and comparison of machine learning models for in-vitro drug permeation prediction from microneedle patch
authors: Biswas AA; Dhondale MR; Singh M; Agrawal AK; Muthudoss P; Mishra B; Kumar D
journal: European Journal of Pharmaceutics and Biopharmaceutics
relevance_ja: MN in-vitro permeationを直接予測するensemble ML
key_fact_ja: Yuan由来191行でvoting regressorのpercentage RMSE 3.24、percentageから換算したamount RMSE 654.94を報告
limitation_ja: 同じ191行の再解析で外部実験ではなく、curve階層を無視したCVなら情報漏洩の可能性

title: Metabolism and retention of verapamil dictate microneedle-based drug delivery: analytical and numerical study
authors: Bhuimali T; Sarifuddin; Mandal PK
journal: Proceedings of the Royal Society A: Mathematical, Physical and Engineering Sciences
relevance_ja: MN verapamilのmetabolism・retention・bindingを直接モデル化
key_fact_ja: 1D reaction–diffusion、blood–tissue reversible uptake、receptor bindingを結合し、binding無視はdeliveryを過大評価し得ると報告
limitation_ja: monolayer、constant diffusivity、1Dのreduced modelでprospective validationではない

title: Numerical study of doxorubicin transdermal delivery for breast cancer treatment using microneedles
authors: Barhoumi H; Kouassi MC; Kallel A
journal: International Journal for Numerical Methods in Biomedical Engineering
relevance_ja: Fick＋FEでMN doxorubicin皮膚・腫瘍輸送を直接モデル化
key_fact_ja: human cadaver Franz dataから層別diffusivityをfitし、tip diameter・spacing・tumor depthを2D/3Dで解析
limitation_ja: diffusivityはfit値で別実験の外部誤差を確認できず、doxorubicin条件に特化

title: Predictive modeling of skin permeability for molecules: Investigating FDA-approved drug permeability with various AI algorithms
authors: Abdallah RM; Hasan HE; Hammad A
relevance_ja: drug-only passive skin priorとして補助的に関連
key_fact_ja: 140 molecules・441 records・145 descriptorsの85:15 splitでLGBM test R² 0.819、RMSE 0.437を報告
limitation_ja: intact skinでMNを含まず、同一分子recordsをgroup splitした記載がない

title: Prediction of drug permeation through microneedled skin by machine learning
authors: Yuan Y; Han Y; Yap CW; Kochhar JS; Li H; Xiang X; Kang L
relevance_ja: MN処理皮膚をMLとFickで直接比較する中心論文
key_fact_ja: 6 drugs・191 pointsのrandom 7:3 splitでXGBoost amount/percentage R² 0.98、Fick percentage R² 0.82を報告
limitation_ja: row-level splitでcurve/drug/study holdoutではなく、未知drug・独立run性能ではない

title: Mathematical modelling of microneedle-mediated transdermal delivery of drug nanocarriers into skin tissue and circulatory system
authors: Newell B; Zhan W
relevance_ja: MN＋nanocarrierのskin layers・blood輸送を直接モデル化
key_fact_ja: loading、spacing、release、diffusivity、transvascular permeability、partition、MN length、environmentの影響を解析
limitation_ja: numerical sensitivityで実験的予測誤差を示さず、plain drugとnanocarrierを混同できない

title: Biphasic burst and sustained transdermal delivery in vivo using an AI-optimized 3D-printed MN patch
authors: Bagde A; Dev S; Madhavi KSL; Spencer SD; Kalvala A; Nathani A; Salau O; Mosley-Kellum K; Dalvaigari H; Rajaraman S; Kundu A; Singh M
relevance_ja: AI/QbD designとex vivo permeation・in vivo PKを接続
key_fact_ja: ibuprofen MNでhuman cadaver skin約2 mg/cm² at 72 h、flux約40 µg/cm²/h、ratでbiphasic PKを報告
limitation_ja: AI主対象はprinting/morphologyで、未知条件のpermeation予測研究ではない

title: In Silico Prediction of Skin Permeability Using a Two-QSAR Approach
authors: Wu YW; Ta GH; Lung YC; Weng CF; Leong MK
relevance_ja: human skin drug priorとvalidation設計として補助的に関連
key_fact_ja: 73 train・18 testとchemical-space outliersでHSVR test q² 0.84、RMSE 0.37、outlier q² 0.86を報告
limitation_ja: intact human skin log KpでMN geometry・microchannel・releaseを含まない

title: A new computational method of modeling and evaluation of dissolving microneedle for drug delivery applications: Extension to theoretical modeling of a novel design of microneedle (array in array) for efficient drug delivery
authors: Zoudani EL; Soltani M
relevance_ja: DMN dissolutionとporous-tissue drug transportをモデル化
key_fact_ja: corneal delivery実験でframeworkを検証し、loading・pitch・partial insertionとarray-in-array designを解析
limitation_ja: 検証組織はcorneaでcutaneous skinへparameterを直接転用できない

title: Mathematical Modelling, Simulation and Optimisation of Microneedles for Transdermal Drug Delivery: Trends and Progress
authors: Yadav PR; Han T; Olatunji O; Pattanayek SK; Das DB
relevance_ja: MN modeling全体の理論・分類を整理する直接関連レビュー
key_fact_ja: geometry/material、skin mechanics、diffusion、dissolution、flow、optimisationを2020年まで体系化
limitation_ja: reviewで新規性能値を生まず、2020年以後のML/multiphysicsは別文献で補う

title: Modelling the intradermal delivery of microneedle array patches for long-acting antiretrovirals using PBPK
authors: Rajoli RKR; Flexner C; Chiong J; Owen A; Donnelly RF; Larrañeta E; Siccardi M
journal: European Journal of Pharmaceutics and Biopharmaceutics
relevance_ja: MN permeated amountをsystemic exposureへ接続する補助モデル
key_fact_ja: cabotegravir/rilpivirine PBPKをrat intradermal/IMとhealthy-adult IM dataでqualifyし、MAP dose・release・patch sizeを探索
limitation_ja: human MAP intradermal clinical dataによるprospective validationではない

title: Using a simple equation to predict the microporation-enhanced transdermal drug flux
authors: Rzhevskiy AS; Telaprolu K; Mohammed YH; Grice JE; Roberts MS; Anissimov YG
journal: European Journal of Pharmaceutics and Biopharmaceutics
relevance_ja: MN roller処理human skinのfluxを直接予測
key_fact_ja: 3 corticosteroidsで複雑式と簡略式を実測比較し、literature regressionとlaser-microporated methotrexateで追加検証
limitation_ja: 主検証は3 corticosteroidsと特定microporation条件で、全薬物へ外挿できない

title: Space- and time-resolved investigation on diffusion kinetics of human skin following macromolecule delivery by microneedle arrays
authors: Wei JCJ; Haridass IN; Crichton ML; Mohammed YH; Meliga SC; Sanchez WY; Grice JE; Benson HAE; Roberts MS; Kendall MAF
relevance_ja: MN後のhuman skin層別Fick diffusivityを直接測定
key_fact_ja: 70・500・2000 kDa dextranでepidermis D 1–8、dermis 1–20、junction 0.7–3 µm²/sを報告
limitation_ja: macromolecular dextran/Nanopatch値で小分子や別MNへ直接転用できない

title: A microneedle-based method for the characterization of diffusion in skin tissue using doxorubicin as a model drug
authors: Mansoor I; Lai J; Ranamukhaarachchi S; Schmitt V; Lambert D; Dutz J; Häfeli UO; Stoeber B
relevance_ja: hollow MN後のdrug diffusivity測定法として直接関連
key_fact_ja: pig skin doxorubicin Dはfresh 4.61×10⁻⁹、refrigerated 1.31×10⁻⁸、frozen 4.21×10⁻⁸ cm²/s
limitation_ja: pig skin・doxorubicin値であり、人皮膚/他薬物のDではない

title: Modelling of dissolving microneedles for transdermal drug delivery: Theoretical and experimental aspects
authors: Kim KS; Ita K; Simon L
relevance_ja: DMN dissolutionとskin drug fateを直接モデル化
key_fact_ja: fentanylでconcentrationはMN mass fractionに比例し、smaller pitchでdeliveryが増えると予測
limitation_ja: 特定fentanyl modelのparameterを異なるpolymer/drugへ固定できない

title: Modelling transdermal drug delivery using microneedles: effect of geometry on drug transport behaviour
authors: Olatunji O; Das DB; Nassehi V
relevance_ja: MN geometry・compressive strain・skin diffusionを直接結ぶ基礎モデル
key_fact_ja: constant Dとstrain-dependent Dでtip-radius効果が大きく異なることを定量提示
limitation_ja: 数値例を普遍的fluxとして使えず、新しいstrain/array研究で更新が必要

title: Predicting Skin Permeability
authors: Potts RO; Guy RH
relevance_ja: drug physicochemical priorとsimple baselineとして補助的に関連
key_fact_ja: 90超の化合物でMWまたはmolecular volumeとlogPからpassive epidermal Kpを予測
limitation_ja: intact SCの古いpassive modelでMN microchannel・polymer release・strainを含まない
